findings.description: Protected placement is corrected, but both lifetime helpers can remove a fixture while an unknown writer remains live.
findings.evidence: Exact current runner helper returns normally and deletes its root while a real audit-owned writer holds the same inode through an external hardlink; link count changes from 2 to 1. Its pathname-only writer scan misses that alias and remove_owned lacks the executor helper's single-link check. Executor test:1492-1496 also deletes roots with ordinary or unlinked live external writing FDs because it proves only descendant reap. Controls: both helpers clean a stopped ordinary writer; executor retains linked entries; runner retains ordinary and unlinked live FDs. /tmp/e-test-g3/lifetimes.json and os-controls.json contain actual identities/outcomes, not C/E behavior.
findings.fix: Extend only the owned fixture lifetime glue: retain regular entries with multiple links, and independently bound/revalidate writer exclusion, including open/unlinked identities and aliases, before authorizing removal. Reap only proven owned children; retain roots on unknown/live/foreign references. Preserve all 233 IDs, source/P path policy and legacy ASTs; no global temporary-root override.

findings.description: Normal process disappearance can fail the containment monitor before the intended test boundary.
findings.evidence: The first exact current factory/isolation audit exited 1: inventory -> _er_identity -> /proc/<pid>/stat.read_text raised ProcessLookupError(ESRCH). inventory catches only FileNotFoundError at line1370, so it killed/reaped the callback and retained its partially constructed fixture before any E call. The same current factory projections qualify 171 executor leaves/inventories under synchronous protected ownership; ordinary real-child and bounded-work isolation controls pass. Raw trace and reconstructed first script are retained in logs/fixtures.attempt1.* and snapshots/fixtures.attempt1.reconstructed.py. This is test-instrument failure, not E RED.
findings.fix: Handle the native process-disappearance outcomes of the bounded /proc census, including ESRCH during read, without treating disappearance alone as product failure or live-exit proof. Retain independently captured identities, bounded teardown/reap and uncertainty handling. Add a bounded real short-lived-child control; do not pace callbacks to hide the race or alter source tests in this review lane.
